items.title: Bill Bourgeois Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: But I wasn't on there. Bill Bourgeois on bass, August Schilling on drums. ... These tunes we used to do in Nick's.

ctx.x: Let me show you what I mean about Sharky having a guitar player. Hold on a second, I'll turn it off.
Meyer Weinberg. That must be New Orleans, huh? Yeah, Julian Lane, Meyer Weinberg, Dave Weinstein, tenor, Ormond Hubb. But I wasn't on there. Bill Bourgeois on bass, August Schilling on drums.
That sounds like a New Orleans band. I didn't know Ormond ever went to New York.
